Subject: Need help with a tenancy eviction case

Hello, my name is Smita DSouza. I am a 62-year-old government clerk living in Thiruvananthapuram. I have a tenancy problem with Pallavi Desai involving 5 lakh rupees in rent, and the tenant has stopped paying rent for many months. My case number is R.C.A. No. 780/2021 in the Thiruvananthapuram District Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 81489 06590 or email smita.dsouza37@example.in.
